<reason>CON won the live comparison: the public paycheck is a tribal stamp, firewalls still route through one-party local power, and a captured desk can be worse than darkness. PRO was strong on the vacuum and substitutes’ absence, but retreated from trust, never escaped the hard-case appointment problem, and spent too much of the debate beating a void CON did not have to defend.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>CON’s A2 on Q2: a captured county desk certifies innocence, occupies the vacuum, and crowds out independent watchdogs—then the closing split-audience reply killed PRO’s alleged contradiction.</best_rebuttal>
